about: Shared WTL conformance fixtures. L0 must pass on #552 today. L1/L2 are acceptance criteria for WIR v0.2 backends; the harness runs them as todo until a backend claims them.

result_contract.checkpoints: [{cycle, face, prev, state, carry}] — prev chains to lineage.root via WCE-1 digests

fixtures.note: #552 canonical example without star(); phases run in canonical order
strict #552 rule: all eight phases required (see D6)
Elder Futhark letters are Unicode category Lo and valid identifiers
source text can never become host code
comparisons parse and evaluate; require passes on true
emits are staged: a failed Verify leaves no output
Kleene logic: unknown is not true, so require fails without becoming false
phase restriction enforced at compile time (an unknown-statement error does not count)
runtime faults become failed verdicts and roll back, identically in every backend
each mobius block is its own lineage; #552 raises Duplicate binding here
a one-cycle lineage still writes a checkpoint chained to its root
Transcend output becomes the next Perceive input on the opposite face
the shape of the self is invariant across the twist

expect.error: carry must bind exactly the seeds

fixtures.note: stops when the carry equals the carry two cycles back (tau0 = seeds)
back to the same value on the same face: the Möbius fixed point
carried values are re-verified; cycle 3 fails and leaves only cycles 1-2 committed
